blocks.text: BRISBANE — Australian scientists are calling for a multimillion-dollar international effort to investigate ”the last unexplored place in Antarctica”, which contains enough ice to raise global sea levels by up to four meters. Researchers from 14 countries issued the call on Wednesday, warning that little was known about the vast Wilkes Subglacial Basin in East Antarctica and models could not reliably predict when major ice loss could occur. Australia could lead the study due to its proximity to the basin, they said, but no nation should undertake the research alone. The warning comes weeks after a Climate Council study found more […]...
